query: Plan a 30-day organic LinkedIn and X distribution plan for a B2B SaaS founder who has 3 customer calls, one webinar recording, and a new product launch next month. Include what to do with the source material.
expected_behavior: Defines the audience promise before listing post formats or cadence.
Turns customer calls and the webinar into a repurposing tree or atom map.
Separates content distribution from copywriting, visual production, and measurement judgment.
Names at least one learning metric and the decision it will inform.
Avoids generic daily posting advice without a reason.
